answerCheck.derivedAnswer: D. Each individual has the same probability of being selected.
answerCheck.reason: Simple random sampling treats the population members symmetrically, giving each the same inclusion probability rather than favoring a particular subgroup.
All 50 students have the same inclusion probability, and 5 are selected, giving 5/50 = 1/10.

A random selection of 4 from all 20 pens avoids positional preference without requiring unsupported strata or inspecting the entire box.
